purpose: Close all v7r8 Lab PASS_WITH_FIXES material findings before any Auditor routing or live action.

rate_readiness_toctou.design: Add a commit mode that performs the final 60/59 core-rate proof inside the same sanitized process immediately before exec of the already-reviewed v7r7 static guard. If final readiness is not READY, the v7r7 guard is never invoked and its first-invocation one-shot authority is not consumed.
exact_requirements: commit mode invokes guard only after final READY
at least five external core decrements would be required between final probe and inherited helper threshold failure; this residual must be independently reviewed and explicitly accepted or rejected

repeatable_evidence_publication.design: Serialize publishers with O_NOFOLLOW regular same-UID flock, use 128-bit CSPRNG unique temp generations with O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and no unconditional unlink, and bind status/control by identical generation. Mixed/partial pairs are invalid by contract.

pre_main_ambient_debug_boundary.design: Place a linux-amd64 static -nostdlib launcher ahead of the Go probe. The launcher parses only CODESPACES=true and valid CODESPACE_NAME, constructs an exact two-variable environment, and execve()s the Go probe before any Go runtime startup. The launcher must be root-owned 0555 and have no PT_INTERP.
required_tests: GODEBUG poisoned input removed before Go startup
GOTRACEBACK and arbitrary ambient variables removed

review_requirement: Candidate is not review-ready until Docker/devcontainer/image-identity/workflow integration is exact and a fresh exact-head machine run passes all new race/pre-main/rate-commit tests. Then Fresh Independent Lab re-review is mandatory before any Auditor request.
